messages.author: 7c598f9d5aed052f
messages.subject: geom_boxplot gives me "xyz %*% solve(M) : non-conformable arguments" error after upgrade
parts:
I have a report that I wrote half a year ago and that I want to "recycle", but
something is broken in the upgrade to the latest versions of are and ggplot2
(or so I assume).

I have dput() the data further below. The following code worked well until a
few days agao:

p <- ggplot( hlr, aes( x = mkt, y = LossR, color = Year ) )
p <- p + geom_boxplot()
p <- p + xlab( "Markets" ) + ylab( "Loss Ratio %" )
print( p )

and gave me the graph as attached for the old dataset.

Now I get this error while Sweaving the file:

Error: chunk 6 (label = HLR)
Error in xyz %*% solve(M) : non-conformable arguments
Execution halted

Any hint will be much appreciated!
Thanks,
Rainer

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: geom_boxplot gives me "xyz %*% solve(M) : non-conformable arguments" error after upgrade
parts:
I think it has something to do with running a summary stat (like summary, boxplot, etc) when colour or fill are continuous. Oddly, it seems ok with alpha or size.

set.seed(121)
dat <- data.frame(x=LETTERS[1:3], y=rnorm(30), c=rnorm(30))

# OK
ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=c)) + geom_point(stat="identity")

# Error: colour and fill
ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=c)) + geom_point(stat="summary", fun.y="mean")
ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=c)) + geom_point(stat="summary", fun.y="mean")
# Error in xyz %*% solve(M) : non-conformable arguments

# OK: alpha and size
ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, alpha=c)) + geom_point(stat="summary", fun.y="mean")
ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, size=c)) + geom_point(stat="summary", fun.y="mean")


-Winston
